title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 1.0.0
summary: The first stable Mouse Without Borders Portable release: modern MWB separated from PowerToys and packaged as one self-contained Windows executable.
changes: Ships as one portable MouseWithoutBorders.exe with adjacent preferences and an optional per-user self-install path.
Preserves modern MWB mouse, keyboard, clipboard, file-transfer, drag-and-drop, reconnect, encryption, and machine-matrix behavior without requiring PowerToys.
Includes the accepted classic green application and tray icon plus crisp transparent configured and empty machine artwork.
Keeps machine tiles proportional and fully visible in responsive one-row and two-row layouts at scaled Windows display settings.
Makes one-row/two-row changes repaint atomically so intermediate tile positions no longer flash on screen.
Includes portable settings, first-launch choice, startup controls, focused diagnostics, shortcut controls, and current incoming-file safety improvements.
testing: Install this same 1.0.0 EXE on every connected computer.
Toggle Two Row repeatedly and confirm the matrix moves directly between its finished layouts without displaying partial controls or stale tile fragments.
Confirm all four monitors remain proportional, transparent, and completely visible in both arrangements.
Open About and confirm the displayed product version is 1.0.0.
Briefly recheck mouse, keyboard, clipboard, file transfer, reconnect, and sleep/wake behavior between the real computers.
